testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle template grouping by document type ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders ✔> And the catalog root has no direct template files ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+N to open the new-document template chooser ✔ And the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the metric template folder is selected ✔ And a standard metric part template's details are displayed ✔ And templates are grouped by type ✔ When the user clears Grouped by Type in the template display menu ✔ Then the template gallery displays a flat collection without type group headings ✔ And the details pane continues to display the metric part template information ✔ When the user selects Grouped by Type in the template display menu ✔ Then the gallery displays part, assembly and drawing group headings ✔ And the details pane continues to display the metric part template information
